meta.task: W-01 — replace city and county proxies with trade-area figures
meta.method: A trade area is defined here as a drive-time ring around PARCEL-001. Because the parcel address is withheld for privacy and has not been supplied to any public source, the ring cannot yet be drawn. To avoid pretending, every figure below is labelled with the geography it actually describes and with how far it is from a trade-area figure. Nothing is presented as a trade-area number until G-01 is closed.
meta.rule: value is null whenever the official source does not publish it for a geography that could stand in for the trade area. Never interpolate.

tract_pull_plan.why_these: population, median household income, poverty count, median home value, median gross rent, bachelor's-or-higher count, unemployed count. These are the seven inputs the demand and land-value screens need at tract level.
tract_pull_plan.tract_trend_methodology: Per Census ACS 5-year comparison guidance (S-022), measure tract-level trend using non-overlapping 5-year windows (2014-2019 vs 2019-2024 ACS 5-year, with 2010->2020 tract boundary crosswalk) rather than overlapping vintages. Weight tracts intersecting 1/3/5-mile rings by area or block-group population share in the secure workspace; a synthetic demonstration dataset (data/tracts_demo_a.csv) exists in the repo for pipeline testing only and is never treated as PARCEL-001 evidence.
